name: WatchMe
description: Uruguayan online store of watches, handbags, wallets, sunglasses, jewelry, pens, backpacks and bottles from international brands. Ships to the whole country and offers store and pickup-point collection.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de relojes, carteras, billeteras, lentes, joyería, escritura, mochilas y botellas de marcas internacionales. Envía a todo el país y ofrece retiro en tienda y en puntos de retiro.

ships_to.notes: Delivery from anywhere in the country, with free shipping over a purchase threshold, per the store's shipping page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Pickup at the WatchMe store in Montevideo Shopping and at HOP pickup points in Montevideo and the interior.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Fenicio storefront. Some products show prices in USD and others in UYU.

sources.supports: Store home page: categories, brand and nationwide free-shipping banner
